x-ext:ExternalSurface.intent: An OS-level or external surface outside the app (browser redirect, 3rd-party hosted page).

screen:checkout/ProtectedShell.intent: (protected) route-group layout shell; enforces auth; all checkout and order routes render inside it.

screen:listing/Detail.intent: Public listing detail for one listing (route param :id); shows price, seller, images, Buy CTA.

screen:checkout/Form.intent: Buyer checkout: fulfillment selector, conditional shipping address form, order summary, place-order submit.

screen:checkout/Success.intent: Post-payment success; resolves order via ?session_id (Stripe paid path) or ?order_id (free-item path); shows next steps.

screen:orders/List.intent: User's orders list with tabs: all / purchases / sales / events.

screen:orders/Detail.intent: Full order detail: status timeline, shipping info, cancellation flow, dispute, review actions.

comp:checkout/FulfillmentSelector.intent: Radio card group: pickup (free, seller location) vs shipping (live DHL cost); change triggers quote fetch.

comp:checkout/ShippingAddressForm.intent: Zod-validated address fields (name, street, houseNumber, city, zip, country=DE); rendered only when shipping is selected.

comp:checkout/OrderSummary.intent: Price breakdown: item price, shipping cost (with carrier label), total; driven by live quote and fulfillment state.

vs:checkout/FormState.intent: Checkout form ephemeral state: fulfillmentType, liveQuote, quoteLoading, isSubmitting, error.

vs:orders/TabState.intent: Orders list active tab selection: all | purchases | sales | events.

trig:listing/BuyTap.intent: Tap Buy / Checkout CTA on listing detail page.

trig:checkout/FormAppear.intent: Checkout form mounts; loads listing data and validates session.

trig:checkout/FulfillmentChange.intent: User switches fulfillment radio between pickup and shipping.

trig:checkout/AddressChange.intent: Zip, city, or country field changes; triggers live DHL quote fetch when shipping is selected.

trig:checkout/Submit.intent: User submits the checkout form (place order).

trig:checkout/SuccessAppear.intent: Success page mounts; reads session_id or order_id from URL query params.

trig:orders/ListAppear.intent: Orders list page mounts; loads orders for the active tab.

trig:orders/TabChange.intent: User switches orders tab (all / purchases / sales / events).

trig:orders/RowTap.intent: Tap an order row to navigate to order detail.

trig:orders/DetailAppear.intent: Order detail page mounts; loads full order record.

trig:orders/ConfirmReceiptTap.intent: Buyer taps Confirm Receipt button on order detail.

trig:orders/CreateLabelTap.intent: Seller taps Create Shipping Label on order detail.

trig:orders/RequestCancelTap.intent: Buyer or seller taps Request Cancellation on order detail.

act:listing/GoToCheckout.intent: Push checkout form for this listing; pure nav, no mutation.

act:checkout/LoadListing.intent: Load listing with seller profile from Supabase; sets listing state and validates seller payment capability.

act:checkout/UpdateFulfillment.intent: Set fulfillmentType in checkout form state; resets address form schema when switching to pickup.

act:checkout/RequestQuote.intent: POST /api/shipping/quote for live DHL rate; fires when zip/city/country change and shipping is selected.

act:checkout/PlaceOrder.intent: POST /api/stripe/create-checkout; reserves listing, then either redirects to Stripe (paid) or pushes to success (free).

act:checkout/LoadOrder.intent: Client-side Supabase query on success page: load order by session_id (with retry) or order_id (direct).

act:checkout/TrackPurchase.intent: Fire trackEvent(PURCHASE, { value, currency, transaction_id }) once after order loads on success page.

act:orders/LoadOrders.intent: GET /api/orders; fetches orders + event bookings filtered by active tab (role / type).

act:orders/SwitchTab.intent: Update active tab in orders list view state; triggers order reload.

act:orders/GoToDetail.intent: Push order detail page for the tapped order row.

act:orders/LoadOrderDetail.intent: GET /api/orders/[id]; loads full order with buyer, seller, listing, reviews, disputes.

act:orders/ConfirmReceipt.intent: PATCH /api/orders/[id]; buyer confirms receipt; transitions order to completed and releases escrow.

act:orders/CreateLabel.intent: POST /api/shipping/label/[orderId]; creates shipment, writes label URL and tracking, transitions order to shipped.

act:orders/RequestCancel.intent: PATCH /api/orders/[id]; initiates cancellation request with deadline; buyer or seller initiated.

assert:checkout/IsAuthenticated.intent: Valid user session exists; gates all (protected) routes; failure redirects to /login.

assert:checkout/SellerPaymentsEnabled.intent: seller.stripe_charges_enabled is true; gates checkout initiation for this listing.

assert:checkout/ListingIsActive.intent: listing.status === 'active'; gates checkout and atomic reservation.

assert:checkout/IsFreeOrder.intent: listing.price_cents === 0; determines checkout path (free direct-claim vs Stripe paid).

assert:checkout/ShippingAddressValid.intent: Shipping address form passes zod shippingAddressSchema (name, street, houseNumber, city, 5-digit zip); required when fulfillmentType=shipping.

assert:checkout/RequestBodyValid.intent: POST /api/stripe/create-checkout request body passes zod checkoutRequestSchema including client_nonce UUID.

assert:checkout/RateLimitOk.intent: Rate limit: ≤10 requests/min per user+IP on the create-checkout endpoint.

assert:checkout/ListingNotReserved.intent: listing.status !== 'reserved'; CAS guard preventing double-purchase race condition.

assert:orders/OrderIsPaid.intent: order.status === 'paid'; gates shipping label creation (not already shipped/cancelled/refunded).

assert:orders/IsSeller.intent: user_role === 'seller' on this order; gates seller-only actions: create label, respond to cancellation.

assert:orders/IsBuyer.intent: user_role === 'buyer' on this order; gates buyer-only actions: confirm receipt, open dispute.

assert:orders/NoCancelPending.intent: No active cancellation_request_status on order; gates label creation and some seller actions.

assert:orders/FulfillmentIsShipping.intent: order.fulfillment_type === 'shipping'; gates shipping label creation (not applicable to pickup orders).

assert:webhook/SigValid.intent: Stripe webhook signature verified against STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET (dual-secret: platform + Connect).

assert:webhook/NotDuplicate.intent: No existing orders for this stripe_checkout_session_id; idempotency guard against concurrent webhook delivery.

store:listing/ListingStore.intent: Loaded listing record with seller profile, price, fulfillment_type options, and stripe_charges_enabled flag.

store:checkout/QuoteStore.intent: Live DHL shipping quote: { optionCode, priceCents, currency } or null; display-only, re-quoted server-side at payment.

store:orders/OrderStore.intent: Single order record: status, fulfillment_type, all financial columns, shipping columns, buyer, seller, listing.

store:orders/OrdersListStore.intent: User's orders list (marketplace orders + event bookings) filtered by active tab and user role.

ds:supabase/AuthSession.intent: Supabase auth session; source of current user identity and session token.

ds:supabase/Listings.intent: Supabase listings table; source of listing records, status, price, dimensions, and seller references.

ds:supabase/Orders.intent: Supabase orders table; canonical order records with financial, shipping, status, and payment columns.

ds:supabase/Transactions.intent: Supabase transactions table; payment ledger entries created per order.

ds:supabase/Conversations.intent: Supabase conversations table; buyer-seller chat thread created on order confirmation.

ds:stripe/SigningSecret.intent: Stripe webhook signing secret (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var); used for request signature verification.

ds:shipping/ShippingAPI.intent: Shipping-provider API; live DHL rate quotes and shipment creation.

op:checkout/LoadListing.intent: Supabase select listing joined with seller profile; checks status=active and stripe_charges_enabled.

op:checkout/FetchShippingOptions.intent: POST /api/shipping/quote; calls the shipping API rate quote for DE destination; returns cheapest DHL option or null with reason.

op:checkout/ReserveListing.intent: Atomic UPDATE listings.status → 'reserved'; CAS guard preventing double-purchase; returns 409 if already reserved.

op:checkout/CreateStripeSession.intent: Stripe Checkout Session creation: EUR line items (item + shipping), full order metadata, idempotency key from client_nonce (FR-034).

op:checkout/CreateFreeOrder.intent: Direct INSERT orders + INSERT transactions + UPDATE listing→sold for price_cents=0 items; skips Stripe; returns success URL.

op:orders/FetchOrders.intent: GET /api/orders; queries Supabase for user's marketplace orders and event bookings; filtered by role and type.

op:orders/FetchOrderDetail.intent: GET /api/orders/[id]; loads full order with all joins: buyer profile, seller profile, listing, reviews, disputes.

op:orders/ConfirmReceiptOp.intent: PATCH /api/orders/[id]; transitions order.status → 'completed'; triggers escrow payout release to seller.

op:orders/CreateShippingLabel.intent: POST /api/shipping/label/[orderId]; creates shipment; writes label URL, tracking number, carrier; transitions order → 'shipped'; sets auto_release_at +14d.

op:webhook/HandleStripeEvent.intent: POST /api/webhooks/stripe; handles checkout.session.completed and charge.refunded; system-initiated (no user trigger); creates orders, transactions, conversations; fires notifications.

op:webhook/CreateOrder.intent: INSERT orders row from Stripe session metadata; sets status=paid, captures all financial columns, stripe_checkout_session_id, stripe_payment_intent_id, stripe_charge_id (PI latest_charge resolved once, best-effort; NULL fallback re-retrieves at payout), escrow payment_model.

op:webhook/MarkListingSold.intent: UPDATE listings.status → 'sold'; runs per order item on webhook completion.

op:webhook/CreateConversation.intent: INSERT conversations row for buyer-seller messaging thread; created on order confirmation.

op:webhook/HandleChargeRefunded.intent: charge.refunded settle point (incl. out-of-band Stripe Dashboard refunds); marks all orders for the payment intent refunded with proportional multi-order allocation; voids any minted the shipping API parcel.

op:webhook/VoidShipmentParcel.intent: Cancel the the shipping API parcel of a refunded labelled order so the platform is not billed for a shipment that never goes out; idempotent + best-effort (no-op when unlabelled; failures never block the refund).

fx:checkout/PurchaseTracked.intent: trackEvent(PURCHASE, { value, currency, transaction_id }); fires once on success page after order loads; deduped via hasTracked ref.

fx:checkout/ListingCacheInvalidated.intent: revalidateTag('listings'); busts ISR-cached listing data after listing status change (reserved, sold).

fx:order/BuyerConfirmationEmail.intent: orderConfirmationEmail sent to buyer on webhook checkout.session.completed.

fx:order/SellerNewOrderEmail.intent: newOrderSellerEmail sent to seller on webhook checkout.session.completed.

fx:order/BuyerShippedEmail.intent: orderShippedEmail sent to buyer when seller creates shipping label.

fx:order/SellerLabelEmail.intent: shippingSubmittedEmail sent to seller confirming label creation.

fx:order/BuyerInAppNotification.intent: In-app order_shipped notification to buyer; sent on label creation.

fx:order/SellerInAppNotification.intent: In-app shipping_submitted notification to seller; sent on label creation.

fx:webhook/CartItemsRemoved.intent: DELETE cart_items for purchased listings; cleanup on webhook checkout.session.completed.

x-ext:checkout/StripeCheckout.intent: Stripe-hosted checkout page; buyer completes payment outside the app; returns to /checkout/success via Stripe redirect URL.
